samples.stimulus: In the pie chart shown, each section represents one category of the type of pet owned by the households in a neighborhood survey. The size of each section is labeled as a percent of the whole. The same distribution describes a second, larger group of households. In that group, 160 households own Fish. Each section of the pie chart is a separate category.
samples.question: How many households in the second group own Birds?
samples.explanation: (1) 원그래프에서 각 부채꼴의 값을 읽는다: Fish 20%, Rabbits 25%, Dogs 30%, Birds 10%, Cats 15%. (2) Fish : Birds = 20 : 10 이다. (3) 160 : x = 20 : 10 로 비례식을 세운다. (4) x = 160 × 10 ÷ 20 이다. (5) 따라서 답은 80 이다. 따라서 정답은 80이다.
